derivation: Crate-level #![cfg(not(feature = "native"))] placed at line 1 before all imports/tests so default native builds compile zero tests in this target.

Required flags for all 13 native-only subcommands and 4 mixed subcommands derived strictly from inline clap::Args structs in cli.rs, compile.rs, compile_call.rs, prepare_call.rs, keygen_call.rs, prove_call.rs, verify_call.rs, keygen_signed_call.rs, prepare_signed_call.rs, prove_signed_call.rs, verify_signed_call.rs, prove.rs, verify.rs, replay.rs, inspect.rs, simulate.rs, intent.rs, verify_intent.rs, proof_io.rs, call_io.rs, and signed_call_io.rs.

Function 1 (native_routes_report_unavailable_before_io) iterates a table of all 17 routes across two phases in an owned Drop-guarded temp directory: first with missing inputs (empty root) and second with populated benign sentinels (including a valid moriarty/2 source header for inspect and invalid sentinel bytes for JSON/binary/SRS inputs), verifying exit code 1, empty stdout, stderr containing mori::command::native-unavailable, whitespace-normalized stderr containing the exact fixed unavailability message, and byte-for-byte identical directory tree snapshots before and after each call.

Function 2 (arg_and_clap_precedence_without_native_diagnostic) iterates two tables in an empty Drop-guarded temp directory: (1) representative clap missing-required-argument and conflict invocations expecting exit code 2 without mori::command::native-unavailable, and (2) argument-only semantic validation failures on simulate (--trace without --target), intent (signed profile without --at or without --target), and verify-intent (signed profile without --target) with complete ActionInput/authority/signature/at flags expecting exit code 1 and exact semantic error substrings without mori::command::native-unavailable.
limitations: Unchanged filesystem sentinels, error precedence checks, and static source audit do NOT prove the absence of read-only syscalls (such as stat, open, or metadata checks that do not mutate directory state).
No strace, seccomp, or in-process filesystem interception seam was used or available in standard-Rust subprocess testing.
Neither cargo test --no-default-features nor default native feature test runs were executed in this source-only authoring pass.
summary: Authored compact standard-Rust integration test crates/mori/tests/native_feature_boundary.rs gated by #![cfg(not(feature = "native"))] with two table-driven test functions covering all 17 native/mixed routes across missing and populated sentinel states plus clap exit-2 and argument-only exit-1 precedence checks.
